text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 30 · 云层之间的阶梯瀑布.
Environment:  A network of broad weathered pale stone steps and aqueduct channels winding down an airborne garden island, water spilling in slender falls into a white cloud sea. Ferns and tiny white flowers along edges, distant floating terraces under a warm clear sky. Original tangible fantasy environment, inviting safe-looking broad foreground landing, no people or birds.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Produce a flat CAD-style 2D concept floor/site plan for the reference location. This is a diagram, NOT an illustration or isometric rendering. Camera perpendicular 90 degrees to ground; ALL furniture/structures horizontal footprint symbols only. ABSOLUTELY NO VERTICAL SURFACES OR SCENERY OR OBJECT FRONTS. Black filled wall strips, three thin parallel window lines, door quarter-circle arcs, furniture simple top-down rectangles/circles, stairs parallel lines with UP arrow. White background, flat pale zone colors. No lighting, shadows, depth, photographic textures or fake dimensions. Clearly label zones and access; infer unseen boundaries conservatively as dashed lines. Preserve exact major structure/door/window/furniture layout. Outdoors use paths, terrain contours, tree circles and water polygons. No people/animals. Title CONCEPT PLAN. Same scene: 多题材场景60组 · 30 · 云层之间的阶梯瀑布 Use only flat symbols like a real estate floor plan. No rendering of walls, no horizon, no room illustration, no perspectives. Every object is seen vertically from directly above. NO SCALE BAR OR DIMENSIONS.
